_note: Questions tab of this lesson, taken from the book. Paths are relative to this lesson's folder. One set = one book exercise (ex = its number in the book, page = book page; taskAudio = the instruction read aloud, played at the start of the set). Types: pick (listen, then tap the matching picture; answer = index in pics), yesno (picture + word: tap the tick if they match, the cross if not; answer = true/false). Pictures are shuffled on screen. Ex5 is a "tick" sheet (see js/quiz.js): all pictures at once, each with a tick and a cross.

sets.task: Listen, point, and mark the matching picture.
sets.hint: Listen, then tap the right picture!

sets.task: Look at the picture and the word. Do they match?
sets.hint: Match? Tap the tick. No? Tap the cross.
